theater: 美吉多平原至幼發拉底河

battle.name: 圖特摩斯三世的行動
battle.theater: 美吉多平原至幼發拉底河
battle.brief: 公元前1457年起，圖特摩斯三世率新王國大軍連年北征，前後十七次遠征從美吉多平原一路打到幼發拉底河，把迦南與敘利亞諸邦壓成按年進貢的附庸。卡面的埃及長矛是這支部隊近身廝殺的骨幹：弓兵與車兵撕開敵陣正面，長矛方陣與彎斧完成最後的肉搏。

kit.name: 埃及長矛
kit.history: 早王朝時期的長矛，銅或青銅矛頭綁在木杆上。埃及人用它守城垣，後來也用它收復失地。

countries: 圖特摩斯三世的行動是埃及新王國第十八王朝在黎凡特戰線上持續近三十年的系列遠征，自公元前1457年第一次遠征起，到他在位末年對幼發拉底河一線的戰事止，中間穿插十七次記錄在案的出師。埃及一方以法老本人為全軍最高統帥，之下有丞相、王室書記官，以及負責逐日記錄行程的軍事書記官塔雅內尼；兵種分為以弓矢作戰的射手、以長矛與彎斧作戰的「強臂」步兵、乘六輻輕型戰車的車兵（每車一御者一射手，駕四匹馬），以及負責追擊殘敵的輕騎「哈伊布拉」，另有從努比亞與麥德雅抽調的民兵、海上盟友舍爾登戰士，和數量龐大的搬運、供水、築壘人員。對手陣營在第一階段是以卡迭施王為首的敘利亞—迦南聯盟，包括阿勒頗王、圖尼普王、努哈希什王與美吉多王；聯軍在美吉多城內設防，水源、壕溝與城垣是它的依托，敘利亞諸王的實力多集中在沿海水塘一帶。聯盟背後有米坦尼在推動，這個胡里安王朝控制的幼發拉底河中游，是埃及難以逾越的天險。巴比倫與亞述起初按兵不動，後來轉為送禮，被卡納克的編年史一律改寫成「進貢」；希梯與塞浦路斯的阿拉希亞也各自捲入，而希梯王哈圖西里一世致阿蒙霍特普三世的信中，聲稱曾七次挫敗圖特摩斯三世對舒阿西人的進攻，這段說法真偽有爭議，卻反映西翼戰線確實在反覆消耗埃及的兵力。戰後埃及並未吞併這些邦國，而是改為每年收取貢賦、扣留王子作人質的附庸體系。
countriesEn: Thutmose III's campaigns were a series of expeditions carried out by Egypt's New Kingdom Eighteenth Dynasty on the Levantine front, running over nearly three decades from the first campaign in 1457 BC to the fighting on the Euphrates line late in his reign, with seventeen expeditions recorded between them. On the Egyptian side the pharaoh himself was the supreme commander of the entire army, with a vizier, court scribes, and a military scribe named Tjaneni who kept the day-by-day journal of the marches; the troops were divided into archers, the infantry 'strong arm' (the sphtm) armed with the spear and the khopesh, chariot warriors in light six-spoked cars (each with a driver and an archer, drawn by four horses), and the haibrw, light cavalry who pursued the broken enemy, together with Nubian and Medjay levies, the Sherden allies from the sea, and a very large body of porters, water-carriers and siege labour. The opposing camp in the first phase was a Syrian-Canaanite coalition headed by the king of Kadesh, including the kings of Aleppo and Tunip, the ruler of Nuhashe and the king of Megiddo; the coalition fortified itself inside Megiddo, its strength resting on wells, ditches and walls, with much of the Syrian host posted around the waters of the coastal plain. The coalition was pushed from behind by Mitanni, whose Hurrian dynasty held the middle Euphrates, the natural obstacle to Egyptian advance. Babylonia and Assyria at first stood aside and later sent gifts, which the Karnak annals rewrite as 'tribute'; Hatti and the king of Alashiya in Cyprus were drawn in as well, and in a letter of the Hittite king Hattusili I to Amenhotep III it is claimed that seven times the king of Egypt was checked in his attacks on the Shasu. That claim is of disputed authenticity, but it does show that the western flank was draining Egyptian strength in repeated fighting. After the war Egypt did not annex these states; it converted them into a tribute-paying system of vassals, with princes kept at court as hostages and annual dues collected.
people: 核心人物是法老圖特摩斯三世，埃及名孟赫佩爾拉，登基名「神的勝利屬於他」，史稱「戰神」。他約在公元前1479年即位，與母親哈特謝普蘇特共治近二十一年，直到她在圖特摩斯在位第二十一年第六月十日去世（阿爾曼特石碑記其卒日），新王才完全獨攬軍政，此後把治國重心幾乎全部放在北征上，親自帶兵、宿營於陣前，史料所記的十七次遠征多由他率領。替他把遠征記錄下來的是軍事書記官塔雅內尼：以羊皮紙寫成的逐日日誌是這批戰爭唯一的第一手材料，後來被刻上卡納克阿蒙神廟的編年史大廳，留下奪車、俘人、納貢的清單。埃及朝中，丞相乃西是國王的行政依靠，軍事總督瓦奈在國王遠征時留守本土、主持軍務；後來繼位為王的阿蒙霍特普二世當年已隨軍作戰，日後在卡爾雅的銘文中留下戰役記述。埃及陣營裡最著名的兩位少年將領是塞提一世與拉美西斯二世：塞提在父親拉美西斯一世時代已任國王的旗手與御馬監督，拉美西斯二世年少時則在「大屋」中擔任持矛侍衛，後來在卡迭施之戰的銘文與浮雕中，仍把這段「持矛少年」的身分畫在戰場上，等於替這張卡面留下了最貼切的註腳。敵方留下名字的，是米坦尼的圖舒拉塔——他在阿瑪爾納書信中三度致書阿蒙霍特普三世，並提議以米坦尼公主嫁給圖特摩斯三世，圖特摩斯三世的回信則索要一千里格黃金；卡迭施王、阿勒頗王與圖尼普王的姓名至今無從查考，只能從聯軍名冊與俘虜名單的位置去推測。
peopleEn: The central figure is Pharaoh Thutmose III, Egyptian name Menkheperre, prenomen Netjerneferure, 'the victory of the god belongs to him', and by history the 'Divine Victorious'. He was crowned about 1479 BC and ruled in co-regency with his mother Hatshepsut for nearly twenty-one years, until she died on the tenth day of the sixth month of his twenty-first regnal year, as recorded on the stela from Armant. Only then did the new king take sole control of the state, and from that point he bent almost the whole weight of his government on the northern campaigns, leading the army in person and camping in front of it; the seventeen expeditions preserved in the record were mostly led by him. The man who wrote them down was the military scribe Tjaneni, whose day-by-day journal on parchment is the only first-hand account of these wars, later carved onto the Hall of Annals of Amun-Re at Karnak with its lists of chariots taken, men captured and tribute brought in. At court the vizier Nahsi was the king's administrative support, and the military commander Van stayed in Egypt to hold the home command while the king campaigned; the future Amenhotep II campaigned as a young man and later left his own account of the fighting on his monuments at Karnak. The two most famous junior officers on the Egyptian side were Seti I and Ramesses II: Seti had already served as the king's standard-bearer and overseer of the horses in the time of his father Ramesses I, while the young Ramesses II held the rank of pikeman in the Great House of the King, and in the inscriptions and reliefs of the Battle of Kadesh that 'pikeman youth' is still shown on the field, which supplies the most apt footnote to this card. On the enemy side only Mitanni's Tushratta left a name: he wrote three times to Amenhotep III in the Amarna letters and proposed a Mitanni princess in marriage to Thutmose III, whose reply demanded a thousand leagues of gold. The names of the kings of Kadesh, Aleppo and Tunip are simply not known, and can only be inferred from the positions of the coalition roster and the lists of prisoners.
kits: 卡面上的埃及長矛是這支部隊的標準近身兵器。早王朝時期以銅或青銅矛頭綁在木杆上的形制，到新王國已定型為約二公尺至二公尺半的直杆：前端裝套筒式銅矛頭，尾端加配重，握處常纏皮帶，槍身有時還綁上短矛以備擲投。這支矛是「強臂」步兵的主兵器，與單刃彎斧並列；弓兵在遠處壓制、車兵在正面撞散敵陣之後，長矛方陣與彎斧才接手完成貼身廝殺，圍城時長矛也供工兵攀城與破壞柵牆。與它並列的還有以角、腱與木料製成的複合弓，配青銅或燧石箭鏃；六輻輕型戰車，車前欄板與射手位，駕四馬；皮革包木框的圓盾與弓弦盒；青銅鎬形斧、戰錘與單刃彎斧；以及織有「聖蛇」紋的皇家旗幟與軍帳。運輸與補給是這支部隊最吃緊的部分：四匹馬拉一輛車，另有牛拉貨車與駁船，驢隊負責把穀物、餅、椰棗、葡萄酒與橄欖油從埃及運到前線，水則靠皮囊水壺與沿途鑿井，缺一不可。圖特摩斯三世在第八次遠征中下令在比布魯斯造船，再把船隻由陸路搬過一段陸地運到幼發拉底河上游，說明這支遠征軍的成敗往往取決於水與糧，而不是取決於一次會戰。卡納克阿蒙神廟節慶廳的植物名錄壁畫逐一描出數百種、上逾七百種植物與樹木的名目，可以看作這支部隊補給清單的考古對照。
kitsEn: The Egyptian spear on the card was the standard close-combat arm of this army. The early dynastic form, a copper or bronze head bound to a wooden shaft, had by the New Kingdom settled into a straight shaft some two to two and a half metres long: a socketed copper head at the front, a counterweight at the base, leather wrappings at the grip, and sometimes shorter javelins lashed along the shaft for throwing. The spear was the principal weapon of the sphtm, the infantry 'strong arm', standing beside the single-edged khopesh; the archers pressed from a distance and the chariots broke the enemy front, and only then did the spear ranks and the axes finish the work at close quarters, while in a siege the same spears served the sappers climbing the walls and breaking the palisades. Alongside it stood the composite bow built of horn, sinew and wood, with bronze or flint arrowheads; the light six-spoked war chariot with a front rail and an archer's position, drawn by four horses; round shields of leather over a wooden frame and bow cases; bronze pickaxes, war hammers and single-edged khopesh axes; and the royal banners marked with the uraeus together with the campaign tents. Transport and supply were the most exacting part of this army: four horses drew one chariot, and there were additionally ox-drawn carts and boats, with donkey trains carrying grain, bread, dates, wine and olive oil from Egypt to the front, while water came from leather skins and from wells sunk along the line, and nothing could be done without both. In his eighth campaign Thutmose III had ships built at Byblos and then carried them overland to the upper Euphrates, which shows that the success of this expeditionary army depended on water and grain far more than on any single battle. The botanical register carved in the festival hall of Amun-Re at Karnak lists several hundred, and in all more than seven hundred, plant and tree names, and can be read as the archaeological counterpart of this army's ration list.
tactics: 這位法老的戰術核心是速度、出其不意與車兵衝鋒。埃及每年在氾濫退去、尼羅河水位回落的季節開拔，固定的出征月份、固定的路線與固定的供水程序，使遠征成為可以反覆執行的年度行動。公元前1457年第一次遠征，大軍於第八月二十五日自邊境要塞提亞魯出發，十日後抵加薩，休息一日，再走十一日到耶海姆；抵達前他先遣斥候試探三條北上路線，北線經宰夫提與約克尼安，南線經塔阿納赫，中線則是狹窄的阿魯納谷。將領力勸走較安全的南北兩路，他卻選了最險的谷道，親自率輕步兵與騎射的哈伊布拉清除谷口哨兵，讓車隊魚貫而入。當夜他把大軍調到與敵相對的位置，黎明發動進攻，陣線排成三翼、略呈凹形，兩翼挾住聯軍兩側，國王自居中央；左翼車兵順坡展開，一接觸便深入敵陣，捲起的塵土令雙方都難辨戰況，聯軍當場崩潰。守軍退入美吉多城，埃及人先搶掠敵營，再轉為七個月的圍城：挖壕溝、豎木柵、毀壞城內水源，切斷聯軍仰賴的井，最後迫其開城投降。往後的遠征同樣以圍城工程為骨幹，而跨越大河的關鍵則是陸運船隻；在亞述、巴比倫與米坦尼方向，埃及車兵與步兵習慣在開闊地正面展開，先用密集箭雨削弱敵陣前排，再讓車兵從翼側切進，最後由長矛隊佔住已奪的陣地，追擊殘敵則交給哈伊布拉輕騎。
tacticsEn: The core of this pharaoh's tactical method was speed, surprise and the massed chariot charge. Egypt set out each year in the season when the flood had receded and the level of the Nile had fallen, and the fixed departure months, fixed routes and fixed water procedures turned the expedition into an annual operation that could be repeated. In the first campaign of 1457 BC the army set out on the twenty-fifth day of the eighth month from the border fortress of Tjaru, reached Gaza ten days later, rested one day and marched a further eleven days to arrive at Yehem. Before coming up he sent scouts to test three roads north: the northern route by way of Zefti and Yokneam, the southern route past Taanach, and the central route through the narrow Aruna ravine. His officers urged the safer northern or southern road; he chose instead the most dangerous defile, and personally led the light infantry and the haibrw, the mounted bowmen, to clear the pickets at the mouth of the pass while the chariots followed in single file. During the night he drew the army up opposite the enemy and attacked at dawn with the line in three wings, slightly concave, the two wings threatening the flanks of the coalition while the king held the centre; the left-hand chariot corps deployed down the slope, drove straight into the enemy ranks on contact, and the dust raised by the fighting made it hard for either side to see, and the coalition line collapsed on the spot. The defenders withdrew into Megiddo; the Egyptians first plundered the camp, then converted the affair into a seven-month siege: a ditch dug, a palisade raised, the water supply inside the city destroyed and the wells on which the defenders relied cut off, until surrender was forced. The later campaigns were built on the same siege engineering, while the key to crossing the great rivers was the overland carriage of boats; in the direction of Assyria, Babylonia and Mitanni the Egyptian chariots and infantry customarily deployed in the open, softening the front of the enemy line with dense arrow-fall first, then driving the chariots in from the flanks, and finally holding the won ground with spear ranks, while the broken enemy was chased by the haibrw light horse.
data: 數字方面：圖特摩斯三世先後出師十七次，其中十四次刻在卡納克阿蒙神廟的編年史大廳，另一份同樣出自阿蒙神廟的編年史只列出十次，兩份對照可知他每年北上的常態。公元前1457年第一次遠征的行程可逐日排出：第八月二十五日自提亞魯出發，十日後抵加薩，停留一日，再行十一日抵耶海姆，戰鬥在第三季第一月二十一日，即新月祭之日，按低年代換算約為公元前1457年4月15日，亦有出版物定於同年5月9日，圍城則歷時七個月。兵力：卡納克編年史記埃及方面二萬人、一千輛戰車，聯軍方面估為一萬至一萬五千人；學者雷德福依用水量與運力推算，雙方實際作戰兵力各約一萬零五百至一萬零八百人，戰車各約一千輛。繳獲清單為：俘虜三百四十人、母馬二千零四十一匹、幼馬一百九十一匹、種馬六匹、戰車九百二十四輛、鎧甲二百套、弓五百零二張、牛一千九百二十九頭、綿羊二萬二千五百隻，另有美吉多王的王家鎧甲、戰車與帳桿。時序上，圖特摩斯三世約於公元前1479年即位，與母親共治至她在圖特摩斯在位第二十一年去世，北征幾乎貫穿其獨治時期；阿瑪爾納書信中圖舒拉塔致阿蒙霍特普三世的三封信編為第19、20、21號；他與米坦尼訂立的一份和約，被視為有文字記載以來最早的國際和約條款；卡納克植物名錄壁畫所列植物逾七百種。
dataEn: On numbers: Thutmose III mustered seventeen expeditions, fourteen of them carved on the Hall of Annals of Amun-Re at Karnak, while a second annal from the same sanctuary lists only ten; comparing the two shows how constant the annual departure north was. The itinerary of the first campaign of 1457 BC can be laid out day by day: departure from Tjaru on the twenty-fifth day of the eighth month, arrival at Gaza ten days later, a single day's rest, a further eleven days to Yehem, the battle on the twenty-first day of the first month of the third season, the day of the new-moon feast, which on the low chronology converts to about 15 April 1457 BC, though some publications give 9 May of the same year, and a siege that lasted seven months. On strength: the Karnak annals give 20,000 men and 1,000 chariots for the Egyptians, and estimate the coalition at 10,000 to 15,000; Redford's estimates, drawn from water supply and carrying capacity, put the actual fighting strength of each side at roughly 10,500 to 10,800 men with about 1,000 chariots each. The list of booty reads: 340 prisoners, 2,041 mares, 191 foals, 6 stallions, 924 chariots, 200 suits of armour, 502 bows, 1,929 cattle, 22,500 sheep, together with the royal armour, chariot and tent-poles of the king of Megiddo. On chronology: Thutmose III was crowned about 1479 BC and co-ruled with his mother until her death in his twenty-first regnal year, and the northern campaigns run through almost the whole of his sole rule; the three letters of Tushratta to Amenhotep III in the Amarna corpus are numbered 19, 20 and 21; the treaty he concluded with Mitanni is regarded as the earliest surviving set of international treaty clauses in writing; and the botanical register at Karnak lists more than seven hundred plants.
cause: 打起嚟的理由有遠有近。遠的一層是第十八王朝立國之後，埃及需要把哈特謝普蘇特的和平局面轉成可以年年抽取的秩序；北方的迦南是通往腓尼基與敘利亞商路的大門，控制加薩、比布魯斯與耶斯德列谷一線，就等於掐住海道與內陸商道。近的一層是哈特謝普蘇特之死：她執政期間在北方的督政官員與駐軍收縮，徵貢減弱，附庸王看見新君年幼、決斷未穩，卡迭施王率先脫離，美吉多王跟進，把聯軍主力集結在塔阿納赫一帶的水源旁擺出迎戰陣勢；聯軍的算盤很清楚，只要守住美吉多這個通往幼發拉底河的關口，埃及在亞洲的權勢就會自行萎縮。更深的一層是體制性的：埃及的農業餘糧足以養活一支每年出動的常備軍與龐大的搬運隊伍，王權也需要不斷的戰功來證明阿蒙神所賜的統治合法，於是「每年北征」本身成為王朝的制度。對手一方也並非鬆散：聯軍懂得以水塘、壕溝與城垣為依托，把會戰地點選在自己熟悉的地方；米坦尼控制幼發拉底河中游，等於握有北進的鑰匙，並以聯盟與外交兩手拉住敘利亞諸王；巴比倫與亞述則各自算計，在形勢明朗前不願先押上兵力。於是一場宮廷中的王位交接，最終變成兩個帝國在黎凡特全面較量的導火線。
causeEn: The reasons for fighting work at several distances. The farthest is that after the founding of the Eighteenth Dynasty Egypt needed to convert the peaceful order of Hatshepsut's regency into a system it could levy from year to year; Canaan in the north was the gate onto the Phoenician and Syrian trade routes, and holding the line from Gaza through Byblos to the Jezreel valley meant closing both the coast road and the caravan tracks. The nearest is the death of Hatshepsut: during her rule the Egyptian officials and garrisons in the north contracted and tribute collection weakened, and the vassal kings, seeing a young king whose resolve was not yet tested, judged the moment; the king of Kadesh broke away first, the king of Megiddo followed, and the main body of the coalition was posted around the waters of Taanach in a battle array. The arithmetic of the coalition was plain: hold Megiddo, the gateway to the Euphrates, and Egyptian power in Asia would shrink of its own accord. Deeper still are the structural reasons: Egyptian agricultural surplus could feed a standing army that campaigned every year together with an enormous baggage train, and the monarchy needed continual military achievement to demonstrate the legitimacy of a rule bestowed by Amun, so that the annual campaign northward became itself an institution of the dynasty. The enemy side was not a mob either: the coalition understood how to anchor itself on pools, ditches and walls, choosing the ground of battle where it knew the country; Mitanni, holding the middle Euphrates, possessed the key to any further advance and drew the Syrian princes to it with both alliance and diplomacy; and Babylonia and Assyria each played their own game, unwilling to commit troops before the shape of things was clear. A succession inside the palace thus became the fuse for a general confrontation between two powers in the Levant.
impact: 影響首先是疆域與秩序：埃及在迦南北部重建統治，把美吉多、卡迭施以外的一批腓尼基城邦如西姆拉、烏拉扎、阿爾達塔、圖尼普等逐一納入年貢體系，塞浦路斯的阿拉希亞也送來貢禮，幼發拉底河中游的敘利亞城邦也陸續納入；埃及沒有直接吞併，而是用駐軍、督政、扣人質、收年貢這四重手段維持，這套辦法在此後兩百年裡一直是埃及對外的基本模式。其次是軍制：步兵、弓兵、車兵與輕騎合成一支可遠征的部隊，固定的出征季節、統一的供水與運糧程序、連續的圍城工程技術，都在此定型，並被後來的阿蒙霍特普三世、塞提一世與拉美西斯二世直接沿用。第三是文字：卡納克編年史大廳的戰爭年表，是有明確連續記載可考的遠征記錄之一，後世重建中東青銅時代晚期國際秩序的基本骨架，就是靠這批銘文。第四是外交：與米坦尼的和約樹立了以條款、互贈與邊界為內容的國際協議範式，阿瑪爾納書信時代的平行往來，以及後來米坦尼與埃及長期對抗而不急於決戰的政治邏輯，都由此定型。第五是王權與宗教：圖特摩斯三世自居「戰神」，卡納克的第七門樓與節慶廳把戰爭寫成阿蒙神的意願，戰功由此成為神廟與王室的共同資產。最後是地名的魔力：美吉多自此被引申為世界末日的戰場代號，「哈米吉多頓」之名跨越兩千年流傳，成為跨越信仰的末日預言；一千多年後拉美西斯二世在卡迭施與赫梯交鋒，仍被人視為要重演圖特摩斯三世未竟的北征。
impactEn: The consequences come first in territory and order. Egypt re-established its rule over northern Canaan and drew in one by one the Phoenician cities beyond Megiddo and Kadesh — Simyra, Ullaza, Ardata, Tunip — into a system of annual tribute; the king of Alashiya in Cyprus sent his gifts as well, and the Syrian cities of the middle Euphrates were absorbed in turn. Egypt did not annex outright but held them by four instruments at once: a garrison, a resident commissioner, hostages taken, and annual tribute paid. That system remained the basic Egyptian form of empire for the next two hundred years. Second in military terms: infantry, archers, chariots and light horse were combined into a force capable of campaigning far from home, and the fixed campaigning season, the unified water and ration procedures and the continuous siege engineering were settled here and were taken over directly by Amenhotep III, Seti I and Ramesses II after him. Third in the record: the chronicle of wars on the Hall of Annals at Karnak is one of the few continuous, securely dated sequences of campaign record that survives, and the basic framework by which the international order of the late Bronze Age Levant is reconstructed rests on these inscriptions. Fourth in diplomacy: the treaty with Mitanni set a template for international agreements made of clauses, mutual gifts and frontiers, and both the parallel exchanges of the Amarna letter age and the later political logic by which Egypt and Mitanni fought for a century without ever rushing to a decision were shaped here. Fifth in kingship and religion: Thutmose III presented himself as the 'Divine Victorious', the seventh pylon and the festival hall at Karnak wrote the wars into the will of Amun, and military achievement became a possession shared by temple and crown. Last comes the magic of the place-name: Megiddo was extended into a byword for the battle at the end of the world, and the name Armageddon passed across two thousand years and across every faith as a word for the last battle; more than a millennium later, when Ramesses II met the Hittites at Kadesh, men still read it as an attempt to replay the northern campaign Thutmose III left unfinished.
result: 結果是埃及在會戰上全勝、在戰爭目標上部分達成。第一次遠征在美吉多以一場遭遇戰擊潰聯軍，繳獲九百二十四輛戰車與二百套鎧甲，七個月的圍城之後美吉多開城投降，城市與居民得保，此後聯軍各城一個個遣使請和、開始按年進貢並送王子入埃及為質；圖特摩斯三世隨後年年再出，掃平西姆拉、烏拉扎、阿爾達塔等城，沒收當地穀倉運糧到海港供應駐軍以斷掉叛亂財源，再北上奪取卡爾凱美什，最遠推進到幼發拉底河東岸，逼得米坦尼國王一度逃亡。遠征的極限也在最後幾次顯現：第十次遠征在阿勒頗附近只記十名俘虜，可能是打成平手；最後一次遠征掃平阿爾干圖平原與圖尼普一帶的聯盟據點，仍未能攻下卡迭施，也沒有把米坦尼併入版圖。戰爭以埃及與米坦尼在幼發拉底河一線達成和約收場，雙方交換記載條款的「書」與銀器，邊界大致維持在歐朗特斯河與幼發拉底河之間，埃及終究沒有吞掉上游強國，此後百年雙方在這條河上反覆爭鬥。對埃及自身而言，這十七次遠征的收穫是一整套可複製的帝國機制與一批可供後世反覆引用的戰功記載；對黎凡特而言，則是迦南與敘利亞南部此後數百年被納入一個以底比斯與孟斐斯為中心的秩序，直到赫梯崛起、底比斯陷落，這個秩序才被徹底打散。
resultEn: The result was a complete Egyptian victory in the field and a partial achievement of the war's aims. The first campaign broke the coalition at Megiddo in a chance encounter, took 924 chariots and 200 suits of armour, and after seven months of siege Megiddo opened its gates and surrendered, the town and its inhabitants being spared; the cities of the coalition then sent embassies one after another, began paying tribute by the year and handed over princes to be kept at the Egyptian court. Thutmose III campaigned again the next year and the year after, sweeping Simyra, Ullaza and Ardata, confiscating the local grain stores and moving the grain to the harbours to provision the garrisons so as to cut off the money that had paid for the revolts, then driving north to take Carchemish and pushing as far as the east bank of the Euphrates, forcing the king of Mitanni into flight for a time. The limits of the expeditions showed themselves in the last of them: the tenth campaign near Aleppo enters the record with only ten prisoners and may have ended in stalemate, and the final campaign cleared the coalition strongholds around the plain of Arkanṭu and Tunip but still did not take Kadesh, nor fold Mitanni into the empire. The war closed with a peace between Egypt and Mitanni on the Euphrates line: the two sides exchanged a 'book' recording the terms together with silver vessels, the frontier broadly held between the Orontes and the Euphrates, and Egypt never swallowed the great power upstream; the two states would fight over that river for the next hundred years. For Egypt itself the seventeen campaigns yielded a complete set of imperial mechanisms that could be copied and a body of written achievement for posterity to quote; for the Levant they meant that Canaan and southern Syria would remain for centuries folded into an order centred on Thebes and Memphis, an order that was not finally broken until Hatti rose and Thebes itself fell.
